raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "in-plane domain boundary and dimensions",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 delegates the design domain to Fig. 5. The text gives neither its outline nor its dimensions; 200×200 elements does not establish a unit square. Below, W and H denote domain width and height.",
      "readings": [
        "Full square with W=H=1.",
        "Full rectangle with W=2 and H=1.",
        "Full square with W=H=2, retaining 0.04 and 0.025 as absolute lengths."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The planar formulation does not specify the thickness used in elemental stiffnesses and force conventions.",
      "readings": [
        "Thickness t=1 with loads interpreted as total forces.",
        "Thickness t=0.1 with the same total forces.",
        "Unit-thickness analysis with loads interpreted per unit thickness."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "nodes restrained against vertical displacement",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 says 'center nodes on each side' without identifying whether 'each side' means the two opposing compression sides or all four sides.",
      "readings": [
        "Restrain u_y at the left and right boundary midpoints only.",
        "Restrain u_y at all four boundary midpoints."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "two horizontal compression load patches",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 places the loads around the horizontal symmetry axis, but does not explicitly identify their application boundaries or horizontal coordinates. Fig. 5 is unavailable.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical patches on x=0 and x=W, each centered at y=H/2.",
        "Inset vertical nodal patches on x=0.025W and x=0.975W, each centered at y=H/2."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "traction profile within each 0.04-wide load patch",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 calls the loads distributed but does not specify their spatial profiles.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform distribution over the stated width.",
        "Symmetric triangular distribution, vanishing at the endpoints.",
        "Symmetric parabolic distribution, vanishing at the endpoints."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "assembly of each distributed load into nodal forces",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 does not state endpoint weighting or nodal load assembly. For example, on a unit-height uniform mesh, a 0.04-wide patch spans eight element edges and nine nodes.",
      "readings": [
        "Consistent uniform-traction loading: seven interior nodes receive F/8 each and two endpoint nodes receive F/16 each.",
        "Equal nodal loading: all nine nodes, including endpoints, receive F/9 each."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "meaning of the stated 10^-3 magnitude at each load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 does not explicitly distinguish a patch resultant from a distributed-load intensity.",
      "readings": [
        "Each patch has total resultant F=10^-3.",
        "Each patch has line-load intensity q=10^-3; for a uniform 0.04-wide patch its resultant is 4×10^-5."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "solid regions at the two loads",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 supplies only a width of 0.025. It does not specify the direction of that width, the other dimension, or the complete shape shown in Fig. 5.",
      "readings": [
        "Boundary-attached rectangular pads with inward depth 0.025 and tangential span 0.04.",
        "Boundary-attached square pads of side 0.025, centered at the load midpoints.",
        "Full-height solid end strips with inward thickness 0.025."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "interaction of passive solid pads with filtering and projection",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 declares passive solids, but Sec. 2.1 does not explain how these masks interact with the two filters and three projected realizations.",
      "readings": [
        "Fix raw pad variables to one, include them in neighboring filter averages, and overwrite pad physical densities to one after every projection.",
        "Exclude pad cells from filter averages, renormalize the remaining neighborhoods, and assign pad physical densities of one in every realization."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "lower bound x_min for the density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (19) retains x_min symbolically, but Sec. 3.1 gives no value. The value 0.27 is introduced specifically for the L-beam in Sec. 3.2.",
      "readings": [
        "x_min=0.",
        "x_min=0.001.",
        "x_min=0.27."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial design for the first omega=1 optimization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 describes warm starts for subsequent weights but does not identify the initial pure-compliance design or its x and s fields. Uniform initialization is stated only for Sec. 3.2.",
      "readings": [
        "Outside passive pads, initialize x=1 and s=0.15.",
        "Outside passive pads, initialize x=0.15 and s=1, with x_min≤0.15.",
        "Outside passive pads, initialize x=s=1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initialization and update of the dilated volume limit V_d*",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 says V_d* is continuously updated to enforce the stated blueprint target, but provides no initialization, update equation, cadence, or relaxation.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize V_d*=0.15, then set V_d*=0.15(V_d/V_b) every iteration using current volume fractions.",
        "Initialize V_d*=0.15 and apply that ratio update every 20 iterations.",
        "Initialize V_d*=0.15 and update each iteration using V_d*←0.9V_d*+0.1[0.15(V_d/V_b)]."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MMA numerical update parameters",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.2.3 and Appendix B identify MMA but do not specify move limits, asymptote parameters, or subproblem tolerances.",
      "readings": [
        "Move limit 0.1; initial asymptote distance 0.5 of variable range; decrease/increase factors 0.7/1.2; subproblem tolerance 10^-7.",
        "Move limit 0.2; initial asymptote distance 0.5 of variable range; decrease/increase factors 0.7/1.2; subproblem tolerance 10^-9."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "termination and iterations at the final projection steepness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3 specifies the beta continuation through beta=256, but does not state when optimization terminates or how long the final stage runs.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop after 75 additional iterations at beta=256.",
        "At beta=256, continue until maximum design-variable change is below 10^-3 and volume-constraint violation is below 10^-4.",
        "At beta=256, continue until relative compliance change stays below 10^-6 for 20 iterations and volume-constraint violation is below 10^-4."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "quadrature used to construct bilinear quadrilateral stiffness matrices",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 specifies bilinear quadrilaterals, while Sec. 2.1 explicitly leaves elemental matrices undefined and refers to unavailable code [18]. Quadrature is not specified in the supplied text.",
      "readings": [
        "Fully integrated Q4 elements with 2×2 Gauss integration for both shear and bulk contributions.",
        "Selectively reduced Q4 elements with 2×2 Gauss integration for shear and one-point integration for bulk."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
